title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
The page belongs to the 1975-76 notes on the divided-power de Rham complex. The neighbouring pages in the scan are from SGA 7 IX (Néron models, Barsotti-Tate groups), apparently mis-filed or used as scrap paper, and are unrelated. This page is a self-contained homological computation about graded modules and their truncations.

Setting (reconstructed):
- S is a positively graded k-algebra, plausibly a symmetric or divided-power algebra.
- 𝓜 is the abelian category of graded S-modules.
- For each N, τ_N is truncation to degrees ≤ N (equivalently, passage to a module over the truncated object), with values in a category 𝓜_N.
- φ_{0N} is the right adjoint of τ_N. It reconstructs a graded module from its piece in degrees ≤ N by the formula (φ_{0N}Q)_i = Hom((τ_{N-i}S)[-i], Q). Here τ_{N-i}S = S/S_{>N-i}, placed in degrees i..N.
- φ_ω is the limit/colimit version as N → ∞.

Top half (boxed criterion). The case of interest is N_0 = 0 ≤ N, with the coefficient category C = Mod(k) embedded by i(M) = M ⊗_k S. It is known that each M⊗S lies in the image of φ_{0N}, i.e. M⊗S ≅ φ_{0N}τ_N(M⊗S) = R^0φ_{0N}(τ_N(M⊗S)). The question is when the higher derived functors also vanish: R^nφ_{0N}(τ_N(M⊗S)) = 0 for n > 0. Computing R^nφ_{0N} degree by degree through the adjunction formula turns this into the boxed condition Ext^n_𝓜((τ_{N-i}S)[-i], M⊗_k S) = 0 for n > 0, i ≥ 0. When it holds, free graded modules are 'φ-acyclic', so the derived reconstruction functor Rφ_{0N} is controlled on free objects. This is a standard step toward an equivalence between derived categories of graded modules and of truncated modules, or toward computing Rφ by free resolutions.

Bottom half (formulas for φ_ω). For M of finite presentation:
- Hom_𝓜(M, φ_ω(P_ω)) ≅ lim_N Hom_𝓜(τ_{≤N}M, P).
- If moreover the relevant objects are projective, the derived version holds: Hom(M, Rφ_ω P) ≅ lim_N RHom_𝓜(τ_{≤N}M, P).
- In particular Hom(M, R^nφ_ω P) ≅ lim_N Ext^n_𝓜((τ_{N-i}M)[-i], P).
- Specialising to M = S[i] gives degree-wise formulas: (φ_ω P)_i = lim_N Hom^i(τ_{N-i}S, P), and (R^nφ_ω(τ_ω P))_i ≅ lim_N Ext^n_𝓜(τ_{N-i}(S)[-i], P).

This is a Serre-type 'graded module from its truncations, up to derived corrections' computation, analogous to local cohomology / Γ_* for graded modules. It presumably serves to compare the divided-power de Rham complex (or its graded pieces) with truncated, level-N versions.
errors: The passage from 'R^nφ_{0N}τ_N(M⊗S) = 0' to the boxed Ext-vanishing tacitly uses that φ_{0N} is computed degree-wise by Hom((τ_{N-i}S)[-i], -), and that injective resolutions in the truncated category come from 𝓜. This is plausible, but no justification is given on the page.

The 'si 𝓜 projectif' hypothesis is ambiguous; it is presumably projectivity or finite-presentation conditions on M (or on the τ_{N-i}S) that are needed to commute lim with RHom. Exactness of the filtered colimit commuting with Ext needs finite-presentation-type hypotheses, which are only partially stated.

ideas.what: Right adjoint φ_{0N} to truncation of graded S-modules, with degree formula (φQ)_i = Hom((τ_{N-i}S)[-i], Q)
ideas.modern_name: Right adjoint to restriction / truncation; graded Γ_*-type reconstruction (cf. Serre's theorem on graded modules, local cohomology)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard (Serre FAC, Grothendieck local cohomology SGA 2)
ideas.where_published: Similar formalism of Γ_* and local cohomology in EGA III / SGA 2

ideas.what: Acyclicity criterion for free modules M⊗S under Rφ_{0N}, expressed as Ext vanishing
ideas.modern_name: Ext-vanishing / Koszul-type acyclicity for truncations of graded algebras
ideas.usually_credited_to: Folklore; related to Koszul duality (Priddy 1970, Beilinson-Ginzburg-Soergel)

ideas.what: Derived colimit formula Hom(M, R^nφ_ω P) ≅ lim_N Ext^n(τ_{≤N}M, P)
ideas.modern_name: Commutation of RHom with filtered colimits for finitely presented objects

deep.surprise_reason: Routine working-out of homological algebra (adjoints to truncation, Ext-vanishing criteria) in service of the PD de Rham project. No result beyond standard techniques is visible, and the neighbouring SGA 7 pages are unrelated scrap.
transcription_corrections: Line 3 reads 'N_0^T = 0 ≤ N' — likely 'N_0 = 0 ≤ N'; the superscript is unclear.
The struck-out line reads 'Hom((τ_{N-i}S)[-i], M⊗_k ...)' and is crossed out in the image, not a bracketed insertion.
'et on [?] sait que' is probably 'et on sait que'; the line 'alors on a ... =' leads to 'R^n φ_{0N}(τ_N(M⊗_k S)) = 0 si n > 0'.
Under the first lim on the bottom half, the marginal note reads 'si M de prés. finie'.
'Si de plus 𝓜 projectif' may read 'Si de plus M projectif' (M the module, not the category).
The last three lines begin with struck-out symbols (crossed-out 'R*' / 'H^i'); the intended left-hand sides are (φ_ω(P_ω))_i, (R^*φ_ω(τ_ω P))_i and (R^nφ_ω(τ_ω P))_i.
